name: CoMe: Compress LLMs through Layer Concatenation and Shedding with Learnable
description: CoMe: Compress LLMs through Layer Concatenation and Shedding with Learnable Inter-Layer Interpolation Adapters. Registered in COMPRESSOR_REGISTRY as 'come' and 'come_compressor'.  Mathematical Formulation: 1. Layer Shedding & Uniform Strided Selection:    $$\mathcal{I}_{\text{keep}} = \{i_0, i_1, \dots, i_{K-1}\}, \quad i_k = \left\lfloor k \cdot \frac{L-1}{K-1} \right\rceil$$ 2. Learnable Linear
math_latex: M_{\text{compressed}} = X W_{\text{bridge}}, \quad W_{\text{bridge}} = U_r \Sigma_r V_r^\top

components.name: Factor U (Full-Rank Expansion Projection)
components.math_latex: y_t = z_t (\Sigma_r U_r^\top) + b, \quad U_r \in \mathbb{R}^{d_{out} \times r}

components.name: Residual LoRA / Norm Calibration
components.math_latex: \Delta y_t = x_t (B A)^\top \cdot \frac{\alpha}{r}, \quad A \in \mathbb{R}^{r \times d_{in}}, \; B \in \mathbb{R}^{d_{out} \times r}
